MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN date_part('month', CAST(o.birth_date AS DATE)) > 10 OR (date_part('month', CAST(o.birth_date AS DATE)) = 10 AND date_part('day', CAST(o.birth_date AS DATE)) > 14)
      THEN 2026 - date_part('year', CAST(o.birth_date AS DATE)) - 1
    ELSE 2026 - date_part('year', CAST(o.birth_date AS DATE))
  END AS owner_age
WHERE (o.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND CAST(o.birth_date AS DATE) > CAST('1961-10-14' AS DATE)) OR o.nationality <> 'Israeli-American'
RETURN owner_age AS col1, o.name AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '[0-9]{4}', 0) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CASE
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, '.*/[0-9]{1,2}/.*') THEN CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '/([0-9]{1,2})/', 1) AS INT64)
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'January.*') THEN 1
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'February.*') THEN 2
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'March.*') THEN 3
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'April.*') THEN 4
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'May.*') THEN 5
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'June.*') THEN 6
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'July.*') THEN 7
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'August.*') THEN 8
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'September.*') THEN 9
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'October.*') THEN 10
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'November.*') THEN 11
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, 'December.*') THEN 12
    ELSE 1
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE
    WHEN regexp_matches(o.birth_date, '.*/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}') THEN CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '/[0-9]{1,2}/([0-9]{1,2})', 1) AS INT64)
    ELSE 1
  END AS birth_day
WITH o, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owner_age
WHERE (owner_age < 65) OR (o.nationality IS NOT NULL AND o.nationality <> 'Israeli-American')
RETURN owner_age AS col1, o.name AS col2, o.nationality AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
